impact.text: Complete loss of funds for any user with self-allowance.

precondition_sources.text: The victim owner has obtained a self-allowance through a validator permit signature.

intent_sources.text: WERC7575Vault.withdraw() must verify that msg.sender is the owner or has allowance for the shares before withdrawing on behalf of the owner.
